weaponSpecials.name: Adaptive
weaponSpecials.text: Composite bow adjusts to user's STR bonus.

weaponSpecials.name: Advancing
weaponSpecials.text: 1/round, when you damage a creature you may 5-foot step as a swift action but take -2 to attack rolls until next turn.

weaponSpecials.name: Agile
weaponSpecials.text: Allows the user to use their Dexterity modifier instead of their Strength modifier for damage rolls. Does not grant 1.5x DEX for 2-handing.

weaponSpecials.name: Allying
weaponSpecials.text: Transfer some or all of the wielder's weapon’s enhancement bonus to one weapon being used by an ally of the wielder.

weaponSpecials.name: Ambushing
weaponSpecials.text: After 1 minute of hiding adds enhancement bonus as a competence bonus on Stealth checks. +1d6 damage in surprise round.

weaponSpecials.name: Anarchic
weaponSpecials.text: Counts as chaotic-aligned. +2d6 damage versus lawful creatures.

weaponSpecials.name: Anchoring
weaponSpecials.text: Pin a target in place to stop it from moving.

weaponSpecials.name: Answering
weaponSpecials.text: Counts enhancement bonus as 4 higher (max +5) for the opportune parry and riposte deed.

weaponSpecials.name: Axiomatic
weaponSpecials.text: Counts as lawful-aligned. +2d6 damage versus chaotic creatures.

weaponSpecials.name: Bane
weaponSpecials.text: Treat weapon’s enhancement bonus as +2 higher and deal an extra 2d6 versus designated creature type.

weaponSpecials.name: Beaming
weaponSpecials.text: 1/day can create glowing orbs equal to enhancement bonus that can be used within an attack or full-attack action to act like the Searing Light spell.

weaponSpecials.name: Benevolent
weaponSpecials.text: Add enhancement bonus of weapon to aid another action to grant a bonus on attack rolls.

weaponSpecials.name: Bewildering
weaponSpecials.text: 3/day can inflict the Confused status effect on hit (DC 17 Will).

weaponSpecials.name: Bloodsong
weaponSpecials.text: Gains Keen when under a Raging Song. Crits grant 1d10 temp HP, 2d10 for x3 etc.

weaponSpecials.name: Brawling
weaponSpecials.text: Grants an enhancement bonus on combat maneuver checks equal to the enhancement bonus of the brass knuckles, cestus, sap, or light bludgeoning weapon.

weaponSpecials.name: Brilliant Energy
weaponSpecials.text: Weapon ignores armor and shield bonuses to enemy's AC. Cannot harm undead, constructs, or objects.

weaponSpecials.name: Called
weaponSpecials.text: Teleports weapon within 100 feet to the hand of its wielder as a swift action.

weaponSpecials.name: Compassionate
weaponSpecials.text: When a creature is brought to -1 or lower HP they are automatically stabilized if they are not dead.

weaponSpecials.name: Concealed
weaponSpecials.text: Can transform the weapon into a non-weapon object of same size or smaller.

weaponSpecials.name: Concealed, Lesser
weaponSpecials.text: Can transform into a mundane object of the same size and shape.

weaponSpecials.name: Conductive
weaponSpecials.text: Allows the user to channel their SP or SU ability through the weapon once per round by spending 2 uses of their ability.

weaponSpecials.name: Confounding
weaponSpecials.text: Confirmed crits allow user to spend 1 panache point to attempt a disarm, reposition, sunder, or trip as an immediate action. Gains a bonus equal to enhancement bonus.

weaponSpecials.name: Conserving
weaponSpecials.text: Teleports fired projectiles back to its container.

weaponSpecials.name: Countering
weaponSpecials.text: +2 to CMD versus disarm and sunder. Failure against this weapon allows the wielder to attempt the same combat maneuvers.

weaponSpecials.name: Courageous
weaponSpecials.text: Grants enhancement bonus as a morale bonus versus fear. Adds 1/2 if user already has a morale versus fear.

weaponSpecials.name: Cruel
weaponSpecials.text: Causes creatures under a fear effect to become sickened for 1 round. Wielder gains 5 temp hp when defeating a foe.

weaponSpecials.name: Culling
weaponSpecials.text: Deals 2d6 additional damage when used with Cleave feat tree.

weaponSpecials.name: Cunning
weaponSpecials.text: Gain +4 bonus on crit confirms when you have 5 ranks in associated knowledge skill. +6 at 15 ranks.

weaponSpecials.name: Cyclonic
weaponSpecials.text: Prevents the ranged attack from being impaired by wind, water, and other liquid or gaseous environmental factors.

weaponSpecials.name: Dancing
weaponSpecials.text: Weapon can float around the user for 4 rounds and make attacks.

weaponSpecials.name: Dazzling
weaponSpecials.text: Dazzles all foes adjacent to the bullet’s path or within or adjacent to the cone of a scattershot

weaponSpecials.name: Dazzling Radiance
weaponSpecials.text: When using the Dazzling Display feat the weapon emites a 15ft display (DC 17 Fort) or be Blinded for 2 rounds and Dazzled for 1d4 rounds. Saves are just Dazzled for 1d4 rounds.

weaponSpecials.name: Deadly
weaponSpecials.text: Makes a nonlethal weapon deal lethal damage and allows whips and the like to damage creatures with armor or natural armor.

weaponSpecials.name: Debilitating
weaponSpecials.text: Attacks against enemies who are denied DEX to ac take a -1 to Attack or AC. Sneak attacks increase debilitating injury bewildered or disoriented effects by 1.

weaponSpecials.name: Deceptive
weaponSpecials.text: Adds enhancement bonus to Feint checks. Critical hits grant a feint attempt as an immediate action.

weaponSpecials.name: Defending
weaponSpecials.text: Transfer weapon’s enhancement bonus to AC as a free action, until the wielder's next turn.

weaponSpecials.name: Designating, Greater

weaponSpecials.name: Designating, Lesser

weaponSpecials.name: Dispelling Burst
weaponSpecials.text: Works as if Dispelling. When discharged with a critical hit the dispel check increases by the enhancement bonus or critical multiplier. If the weapon lacks a dispel or greater dispel, the user may cast it as a swift action on a critical hit.

weaponSpecials.name: Disruption

weaponSpecials.name: Guardian
weaponSpecials.text: Transfer weapon’s enhancement bonus to saves as a free action, until the wielder's next turn.

weaponSpecials.name: Heart-Piercing
weaponSpecials.text: As Vorpal weapon but targets hearts. Natural 20s, followed by successful critical confirmation, instantly kills target.

weaponSpecials.name: Heartseeker
weaponSpecials.text: Ignore the miss chance for concealment against most living targets, as long as they have a heart.

weaponSpecials.name: Holy
weaponSpecials.text: Counts as good-aligned. +2d6 damage versus evil creatures.

weaponSpecials.name: Huntsman
weaponSpecials.text: Add enhancement bonus on Survival checks to track any creature the weapon has damaged in the past day. Deals +1d6 damage to creatures the wielder has tracked with Survival in the past day.

weaponSpecials.name: Icy Burst
weaponSpecials.text: +1d6 ice damage, +1d10 ice on a successful critical hit.

weaponSpecials.name: Igniting
weaponSpecials.text: Acts as flaming. +1d6 fire damage and causes the target to gain the burning status effect.

weaponSpecials.name: Impact
weaponSpecials.text: The weapon is treated as if it were 1 size category larger, and gains its enhancement bonus to bull rush CMBs.

weaponSpecials.name: Injecting
weaponSpecials.text: Stores 3 doses of injury poison, can apply 1 dose as a swift action.

weaponSpecials.name: Jetstream
weaponSpecials.text: +1d6 water damage.

weaponSpecials.name: Jetstream Burst
weaponSpecials.text: +1d6 water damage, +1d10 water on a successful critical hit.

weaponSpecials.name: Jurist
weaponSpecials.text: Add enhancement bonus on Perception checks and to CMD for Judge Magister's using judgment.

weaponSpecials.name: Keen
weaponSpecials.text: Doubles the crit range of piercing or slashing melee weapons.

weaponSpecials.name: Ki Focus
weaponSpecials.text: Lets a monk use their ki strike or the stunning fist feat with this weapon as if it were an unarmed attack.

weaponSpecials.name: Ki Intensifying
weaponSpecials.text: Lets a monk use their ki strike or the stunning fist feat with this weapon as if it were an unarmed attack. DC for ki abilities increases by 1/2 enhancement bonus. Can spen 1 ki point as a swift to perform a combat maneuver.

weaponSpecials.name: Kinslayer
weaponSpecials.text: Treat weapon’s enhancement bonus as +2 higher and deal an extra 2d6 versus targets related to the wielder.

weaponSpecials.name: Leveraging
weaponSpecials.text: Adds enhancement bonus to CMD versus bull rush, drag, reposition, and trip. 2x enhancement to CMB to bull rush, drag, reposition, and trip.

weaponSpecials.name: Liberating
weaponSpecials.text: As a standard action, attempt a CMB to remove an effect that inhibits movement such as slow or web.

weaponSpecials.name: Lifesurge
weaponSpecials.text: Enhancment bonus to saves versus necromantic effects and powers of undead. Add enhancement bonus to temp hp gained. Double crit range versus undead. Crits against undead deal +1d8 per crit multiplier over x1, or heal self for half.

weaponSpecials.name: Limning
weaponSpecials.text: On strike inflicts the faerie fire effect for 1 round.

weaponSpecials.name: Lucky
weaponSpecials.text: Weapon has 1 grit point. Can be used for the user's deeds, or to reroll an attack on a misfire.

weaponSpecials.name: Lucky, Greater
weaponSpecials.text: Weapon has 3 grit points. Can be used for the user's deeds, or to reroll an attack on a misfire.

weaponSpecials.name: Max Charged
weaponSpecials.text: Increase damage by 5 dice

weaponSpecials.name: Menacing
weaponSpecials.text: Grants allies flanking a creature you're adjacent to a +2 flanking bonus.

weaponSpecials.name: Merciful
weaponSpecials.text: +1d6 damage, but all damage is nonlethal damage.

weaponSpecials.name: Mighty Cleaving
weaponSpecials.text: Grants user using Cleave 1 extra Cleave.

weaponSpecials.name: Mimetic
weaponSpecials.text: Each strike grants 10 resistance to one energy type the target is resistant/immune to for 1 round, to a max of 30.

weaponSpecials.name: Miserable
weaponSpecials.text: Halves the energy resistances of foes hit, affects creature types like the Bane special ability.

weaponSpecials.name: Negating
weaponSpecials.text: Reduces alignment DR by 5 for 1 round on successful hit.

weaponSpecials.name: Neutralizing
weaponSpecials.text: Purifies water. Deals +1d6 damage to earth subtype. +2 competence bonus on saves versus earth-based effects. Weapon is immune to earth damage.

weaponSpecials.name: Nullifying
weaponSpecials.text: Each successful strike that deals damage also reduces the target's SR by 1 for 1 minute, this stacks with itself.

weaponSpecials.name: Ominous
weaponSpecials.text: Adds enhancement bonus on Intimidate checks. Critical hits inflict shaken for 1 minute (DC 13 Will negates) +1 min per multiplier over x2.

weaponSpecials.name: Overcharged
weaponSpecials.text: Increase damage by 4 dice

weaponSpecials.name: Patriotic
weaponSpecials.text: +4 insight bonus on Bluff, Disguise, and Sleight of Hand checks to conceal the weapon from members of other nationalities. Against flat-footed enemies of different nationalities, DC 13 will or shaken for 1 minute. +2 confirm critical against other nationalities.

weaponSpecials.name: Peaceful
weaponSpecials.text: A creature hit with nonlethal becomes shaken for 1 round every time it deals lethal damage to another living creature.

weaponSpecials.name: Phantom Ammunition⁸
weaponSpecials.text: Fired ammunition dissolves after 1 round of firing.

weaponSpecials.name: Phase Locking
weaponSpecials.text: Creature hit cannot use teleportation for 1 round.

weaponSpecials.name: Planar
weaponSpecials.text: Ignore 5 points of DR of outsiders.

weaponSpecials.name: Plummeting
weaponSpecials.text: Struck creatures must make a fly check (DC 20+2*Enhancement bonus) or fall 10 feet. Failing the fly check causes the target to fall 1d4*10 feet.

weaponSpecials.name: Quad Charged
weaponSpecials.text: Increase damage by 3 dice

weaponSpecials.name: Quenching
weaponSpecials.text: Quenches non-magical fire. Deals +1d6 damage to fire subtype. +2 competence bonus on saves versus fire-based effects. Weapon is immune to fire damage.

weaponSpecials.name: Redeemed
weaponSpecials.text: As Holy weapon, deals 2d6 damage versus evil. Sacred bonus to saves equal to enhancement against evil effects. +5 component to knowledge planes against evil outsiders.

weaponSpecials.name: Reliable
weaponSpecials.text: Reduce misfire chance by 1 (minimum 0).

weaponSpecials.name: Reliable, Greater
weaponSpecials.text: Reduce misfire chance by 4 (minimum 0).

weaponSpecials.name: Repositioning
weaponSpecials.text: Grants a +2 enhancement bonus to reposition a foe. Critical hits allow repositioning as a free action.

weaponSpecials.name: Returning⁶
weaponSpecials.text: Thrown weapon returns just before the next turn.

weaponSpecials.name: Roaring
weaponSpecials.text: +1d6 wind damage.

weaponSpecials.name: Roaring Burst
weaponSpecials.text: +1d6 wind damage, +1d10 wind on a successful critical hit.

weaponSpecials.name: Sapping
weaponSpecials.text: Nonlethal weapons deal 2d6 extra damage. Critical hits Fatigue the target for 5 rounds.

weaponSpecials.name: Seaborne
weaponSpecials.text: Bonus to swim equal to 2x enhancement bonus. No penalties to attack/damage underwater with weapon.

weaponSpecials.name: Second Chance²
weaponSpecials.text: 1/round as a free action, if you miss an attack, you can roll the attack again.

weaponSpecials.name: Seeking
weaponSpecials.text: Ranged weapon ignores concealment.

weaponSpecials.name: Sharding
weaponSpecials.text: Can throw a duplicate of the weapon, 10ft range increments.

weaponSpecials.name: Sharding⁶
weaponSpecials.text: Can throw a duplicate of the weapon, 10ft range increments.

weaponSpecials.name: Shining
weaponSpecials.text: +1d6 holy damage.

weaponSpecials.name: Shining Burst
weaponSpecials.text: +1d6 holy damage, +1d10 holy on a successful critical hit.

weaponSpecials.name: Shock
weaponSpecials.text: +1d6 lightning damage.

weaponSpecials.name: Shocking Burst
weaponSpecials.text: +1d6 lightning damage, +1d10 lightning on a successful critical hit.

weaponSpecials.name: Silencing
weaponSpecials.text: Weapon is silent, causes the target to be muffled, and inflicts silence on a target (Will 13 negates). Higher critical multipliers increase duration and DC.

weaponSpecials.name: Skewering
weaponSpecials.text: When threatening a critical hit, can spend 1 panache point as an immediate action to confirm the crit. Does not give a point for the crit, but does if it kills.

weaponSpecials.name: Slithering
weaponSpecials.text: Lower enemy's cover bonus by 1/2. Add enhancemnet bonus to CMD versus disarm or sunder. Take 1/2 penalty for squeezing on attack rolls.

weaponSpecials.name: Smashing
weaponSpecials.text: Weapon deals an extra 2d6 damage to inanimate objects, including when it is used to sunder armor and weapons.

weaponSpecials.name: Sneaky
weaponSpecials.text: Once/day use your sneak attack without meeting requirements.

weaponSpecials.name: Sniping Afar
weaponSpecials.text: Sneak attack at 45 feet.

weaponSpecials.name: Sniping Stealth
weaponSpecials.text: Weapon gains +5 competence bonus on Stealth checks to remain hidden after sniping with it.

weaponSpecials.name: Sniping Stealth, Greater
weaponSpecials.text: Weapon gains +15 competence bonus on Stealth checks to remain hidden after sniping with it.

weaponSpecials.name: Sniping Stealth, Improved
weaponSpecials.text: Weapon gains +10 competence bonus on Stealth checks to remain hidden after sniping with it.

weaponSpecials.name: Speed
weaponSpecials.text: Gain 1 extra attack at highest BAB, as the haste spell. This is not cumulative with similar effects, such as a haste spell

weaponSpecials.name: Spell Hurling⁶
weaponSpecials.text: Allows the user to spellstrike through a thrown weapon.

weaponSpecials.name: Spell Storing
weaponSpecials.text: Store one spell of 3rd or lower SL. On a successful hit, you may cast said spell on the target.

weaponSpecials.name: Stalking
weaponSpecials.text: Study a target with a standard action. Each round adds 1d6 damage to the first attack against the target, to a max number of dice equal to the weapon's enhancement bonus.

weaponSpecials.name: Sticky
weaponSpecials.text: Critical hits allow user to forgo rolling confirmation and instead make a steal CMB.

weaponSpecials.name: Summon Bane
weaponSpecials.text: Treat weapon’s enhancement bonus as +2 higher and deal an extra 2d6 versus any summoned creatures from summon spells, avatars and eidolons.

weaponSpecials.name: Tailwind
weaponSpecials.text: Acts similarly to the Gust of Wind spell. Negates range penalties up to 60ft.

weaponSpecials.name: Thawing
weaponSpecials.text: Melts non-magical ice. Deals +1d6 damage to ice subtype. +2 competence bonus on saves versus ice-based effects. Weapon is immune to ice damage.

weaponSpecials.name: Throwing
weaponSpecials.text: Grants melee weapon a range increment of 10 feet and can be thrown by a wielder proficient in its normal use.

weaponSpecials.name: Thundering
weaponSpecials.text: 1d8 non-elemental damage on crits, 2d8 with 3x, 3d8 if 4x. Fort 14 or deafened permanently.

weaponSpecials.name: Toxic
weaponSpecials.text: Increases DC of poisons by 2. Has a 25% to not use a dose of poison (1/poison).

weaponSpecials.name: Training
weaponSpecials.text: Stores 1 combat feat that the user may utilize if they meet the prerequisites.

weaponSpecials.name: Transformative
weaponSpecials.text: Can transform the weapon into any other melee weapon of the same general shape and handedness.

weaponSpecials.name: Treasonous
weaponSpecials.text: As a Patriotic weapon but when wielded against a member of the attuned nationality its enhancement bonus is +2 higher and deals 2d6 damage.

weaponSpecials.name: Triple Charged
weaponSpecials.text: Increase damage by 2 dice

weaponSpecials.name: Truthful
weaponSpecials.text: Ignore concealment due to illusions, as well as mirror image. May dispel figments with a stored dispel.

weaponSpecials.name: Umbral
weaponSpecials.text: Grant weapon concealment. Create 20ft radius darkness to drop light by 1 level.

weaponSpecials.name: Underwater
weaponSpecials.text: Weapon does not take the -2 penalty for attacking underwater, and they deal full damage.

weaponSpecials.name: Unholy
weaponSpecials.text: Counts as evil-aligned. +2d6 damage versus good creatures.

weaponSpecials.name: Unseen
weaponSpecials.text: Turn weapon invisible, first attack in combat denies dex. Easy to conceal via sight. Weapon has total concealment against disarm, steal, and sunder.

weaponSpecials.name: Valiant
weaponSpecials.text: Grants a chocobo knight +1d6 damage versus foes under their challenge ability. +2 CMB to disarm or sunder challenge foe, +4 CMD versus disarm and sunder from foe.

weaponSpecials.name: Vampiric
weaponSpecials.text: Heals 1/2 damage dealt to a max of 2x user's HD per day.

weaponSpecials.name: Vampiric, Greater
weaponSpecials.text: Heals 1/2 damage dealt to a max of 5x user's HD per day.

weaponSpecials.name: Veering
weaponSpecials.text: Ignore target's bonus to AC from partial cover and reduce the target’s bonus to AC from cover and soft cover by 2.

weaponSpecials.name: Vicious
weaponSpecials.text: +2d6 damage but take 1d6 damage per hit.

weaponSpecials.name: Vorpal
weaponSpecials.text: On a natural 20, and confirmed critical, you sever the target's head, killing them instantly.

weaponSpecials.name: Wounding
weaponSpecials.text: Inflict 1 bleed on hit, stacking with itself.
